name: Interacti Forms Connector For monday
author: jeffh30

sections.description:
This helper plugin acts as a secure connector bridge between your WordPress site and monday.com. It allows you to dynamically fetch your form lists and schemas inside monday.com for field mapping, and routes incoming submissions securely into your workspace boards.

Important SaaS & Privacy Disclosures

This plugin is a companion integration that relies on an external service to process and map form data to monday.com.

  • External Service Name: WordPress Forms Integration (monday.com app)
  • Terms of Service: https://www.interactidigital.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.interactidigital.com/privacy-policy

What Data is Transmitted?

No data is sent externally until you generate an integration token and connect your site inside the monday.com app. Once connected, the following data is transmitted to our secure region-specific middleware endpoints (*.monday.app):
* Connection Phase: Your site URL and the list of active form configurations (Form ID and Title) to populate your monday.com mapping dropdowns.
* On Submission: When a user submits a connected form, the raw field names, field types, and user-submitted text values are securely sent to our middleware to be formatted and written to your designated monday.com board.

Supported Builders in this release:
* WPForms (Free & Pro)
* Gravity Forms
* Contact Form 7
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Interacti Forms Connector for monday.com.
  3. Generate an integration token.
  4. Copy your Site URL and Token, then paste them into the WordPress Forms Integration app inside your monday.com integration setup.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without the monday.com marketplace app?

No, this is a dedicated connector designed specifically to power the WordPress Forms Integration app inside the monday.com ecosystem.

How do I stop all data transmissions?

Navigate to the plugin’s settings page in your WordPress dashboard and click “Revoke token”. This immediately invalidates the shared secret and prevents any further data from leaving your site.
